gloss: overall situation; big picture; general situation

definitions.gloss: overall situation; big picture; general state of affairs
definitions.explanation: The broad, strategic view of a situation, as opposed to individual details. Used when discussing matters from a high-level perspective.

examples.japanese: {大局|たいきょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧。
examples.english: To judge by looking at the big picture.

examples.japanese: {大局|たいきょく}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な⟦{視点|してん}→視点：03187_shiten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわら→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧ず、{大局|たいきょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見失|みうしな}わない→見失う：14129_miushinau⟧ようにし⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: We must not get caught up in the details and lose sight of the big picture.

notes:
Composed of {大|たい} (big) and ⟦{局|きょく}→局：02687_kyoku⟧ (situation, phase). Used for strategic thinking where one steps back from details to consider the whole.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大局|たいきょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look at the big picture
- {大局|たいきょく}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: big-picture, from an overall perspective
- {大局|たいきょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見失|みうしな}う→見失う：14129_miushinau⟧: to lose sight of the big picture
- {大局|たいきょく}{観|かん}: a broad perspective
- {大局|たいきょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to take a big-picture standpoint

USAGE:
Often used in business, politics, and strategic discussions. The derived form {大局|たいきょく}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (big-picture, overall) is very common as an adjectival modifier.
The homophone ⟦{対局|たいきょく}→対局：17420_taikyoku⟧ means a game (of go, shogi, etc.) — completely different meaning.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧: the whole — more concrete, refers to all parts combined
- {大局|たいきょく}: big picture — strategic overview, more abstract
- ⟦{全貌|ぜんぼう}→全貌：21553_zenbou⟧: full picture — complete view of something being investigated
- {概観|がいかん}: general survey — an overview or broad look
